title: A garden makeover
summary: A realistic before-and-after, animated from a single start picture.

scenes.prompt:
3D Pixar-style cartoon animation, bright friendly colors, expressive characters. Maintain the exact art style, characters, lighting and layout of the starting frame.

Create a 10-second vertical 9:16 ultra-photorealistic cinematic transformation video using the supplied Scene 3 start image as the EXACT reference.

STORY STAGE:
SECOND TRANSFORMATION → WOW.

This is the final payoff. The restored but unfinished courtyard must transform into an extraordinary private Mediterranean luxury spa oasis.

NO DIALOGUE. NO VOICEOVER.
Use only satisfying environmental, water, construction and transformation SFX.

CRITICAL:
Preserve the EXACT circular sunken stone plunge pool, central stone feature, courtyard dimensions, walls, windows, ivy-covered architecture and camera direction.

Do NOT replace the plunge pool with a different modern swimming pool.

0.0–2.0 SEC — WATER TRANSFORMATION

Begin immediately. No opening pause.

Crystal-clear turquoise water rapidly flows into the EMPTY circular plunge pool from several existing water outlets.

Show the water level visibly rising.

The water should physically interact with the stone basin, creating realistic ripples, reflections and splashes.

As water reaches the central stone feature, it activates as a gentle bubbling fountain.

SFX: rushing water → splash → bubbling fountain.

2.0–4.0 SEC — LANDSCAPE TRANSFORMATION

Without stopping the action, shift attention around the pool.

Remaining messy courtyard edges become beautifully finished.

Loose dirt clears away.
Stone paving becomes clean and polished.
Existing greenery is professionally trimmed.
Elegant Mediterranean plants and flowering greenery fill selected planters.

Do NOT completely replace the existing ivy.
Refine it so the original courtyard remains recognizable.

Camera makes a smooth sideways arc around the plunge pool.

4.0–6.0 SEC — LUXURY LAYER

Premium outdoor elements are installed in rapid but believable physical movements:

two elegant lounge chairs slide into position;
a small luxury side table is placed;
soft cream cushions settle naturally;
large terracotta planters become professionally arranged;
subtle decorative details complete the courtyard.

Keep the plunge pool visible as the hero object.

No random object teleportation.

6.0–8.0 SEC — ATMOSPHERE TRANSFORMATION

Lighting gradually transitions from late afternoon toward warm golden-hour evening.

Existing wall lanterns illuminate sequentially.

Hidden warm architectural lights activate around the pool edge and plants.

The turquoise water catches the golden reflections.

A SMALL amount of realistic warm steam begins rising from the plunge pool.

The courtyard should suddenly feel like a five-star private Mediterranean spa.

SFX: subtle lighting clicks, bubbling water, gentle evening ambience.

8.0–10.0 SEC — WOW

This is the biggest payoff.

Camera smoothly pulls backward AND slightly upward, revealing the entire SAME courtyard.

Show:

the glowing circular stone plunge pool,
crystal-clear turquoise water,
gentle central fountain,
subtle steam,
beautiful preserved ivy,
luxury lounge chairs,
Mediterranean plants,
warm architectural lighting,
clean stone paving,
and the original arched architecture.

Create a breathtaking luxury-resort hero shot.

The final 1.5–2 seconds must remain visually readable while the camera continues a very slow cinematic movement.

The viewer must clearly understand:

THIS IS THE SAME ABANDONED COURTYARD FROM THE BEGINNING.

FINAL LOOK:
High-end Mediterranean boutique hotel spa.
Warm golden-hour/evening atmosphere.
Cinematic reflections.
Premium but believable.
Photorealistic.
Not fantasy.

IMPORTANT NEGATIVE INSTRUCTIONS:

Do NOT change the shape or size of the circular plunge pool.
Do NOT remove the central stone feature.
Do NOT create a rectangular swimming pool.
Do NOT change the building.
Do NOT change windows or doors.
Do NOT create new floors/buildings.
Do NOT add people.
Do NOT add a giant pergola.
Do NOT overcrowd the courtyard.
Do NOT instantly jump to the finished result.
Do NOT use magical flashes.
Do NOT teleport everything simultaneously.
Do NOT create dead frames.
Do NOT finish the transformation before 8 seconds.

Every 1–2 seconds must introduce a new visible upgrade.

The strongest completed appearance MUST occur only during the final 2 seconds.

Narration voice: a warm, sunny female narrator.

Playful, upbeat background music.

No text overlays, no logos, no watermarks.
